fact: Egyptian Tax Authority head Rasha Abdel Aal said taxpayers have responded to the electronic systems and the mobile app and have already started creating accounts and submitting returns electronically.
Finance minister Ahmed Kouchouk said real estate transactions tax can be paid electronically by bank cards or direct-debit cards, with a final clearance issued online in five steps.

The Egyptian Tax Authority head says employers compute wage tax on its unified platform, by payroll integration, Excel upload or manual entry, and the authority launched an employee portal issuing payslips.

Enterprise reports the Tax Authority's Director of Taxpayer Services saying that 134 large companies must file returns electronically before the end of the year and over 2,500 more in a second phase in 1Q2021, with the date taken as late 2020 from the text.
